name: jira
description: Jira Cloud tools: search with JQL, read an issue with its comments, create, comment and move issues through the workflow.

config.label: Jira site
config.hint: Your Jira address without https://, like yourcompany.atlassian.net.

config.label: Account e-mail
config.hint: The e-mail of the Atlassian account the API token belongs to.

config.label: API token
config.hint: Create one at id.atlassian.com/manage-profile/security/api-tokens. Write it as ${ENV_VAR} to keep it out of the settings file.

config.label: Default project key
config.hint: Optional. Like CNSUP. Used when a new issue names no project.

config.label: Projects the agent may change
config.hint: Required to create, comment or move issues; empty means read only. Comma separated keys, like CNSUP, OPS, or * for any project. Searching and reading are never limited by it.
